# Gothic Vault

> Gothic Vault — Goth Accessories. An online store specialising in gothic jewellery, chokers, rings, bat & skull pendants, and dark alternative fashion.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured collections, hero stories, and brand highlights.
- [Shop](/shop): Browse the full catalog of goth accessories and gothic jewellery.
- [About](/about): Brand story and the people behind Gothic Vault.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch via email, phone, or WhatsApp.
- [Track Order](/track-order): Track an order by order number or phone.
- [Policies](/policies): Shipping, returns, privacy, and terms.

## Optional

- [Cart](/cart): Current shopping cart.
